message.reasoning:
We need to generate unit test code for findLexicalRoot covering cases described in JSON. Already there are two tests in framework: one where child has id parent, and one where none have id. Need to add more tests to cover other cases: root has id (returns itself), leaf with no id and no parent (returns itself), child with parent has id (already covered), grandchild with mid no id, root has id (needs test), deep leaf with all ancestors no id (returns topmost). Also need to use reflection if hasId is private? In JsonSchema class, field hasId is private, but we can set it via reflection after constructing schema via JsonSchema.from. However the from method likely sets hasId based on $id presence. In tests we can create schemas with $id to set hasId true. For schemas without $id, hasId will be false. So we can use JsonSchema.from to create rootSchema with $id to have hasId true. For leaf with no parent and no id, we can create a schema with no $id and parent null. That's root schema without id. That will have hasId false. findLexicalRoot should return itself (since while loop condition !ancestor.hasId true, then parent null => break, return ancestor which is itself). So test that.

For root with id and parent null, findLexicalRoot returns itself. Already covered by first test? Not exactly; we need test where schemaInstance is rootSchema(hasId=true,parent=null). We'll create root schema with $id and call findLexicalRoot on it.

For deep leaf with all ancestors no id: chain of 3 levels with no $id. findLexicalRoot should return topmost (root). Already have test NoIdInChain_ReturnsTopmostSchema which creates root and child both without $id, returns root. That covers deep leaf with two levels. But we may also test deeper chain (grandchild). Already have test for grandChild where root has id. That's covered by existing test? Not yet. So we need tests for grandChild with root having id but intermediate not. Also test deep leaf all no id (maybe more than two levels). The existing NoIdInChain test uses root and child only; we can add a test with three levels.

We need to keep framework's @BeforeAll etc unchanged.

Add test methods using @Test.

Implement using JsonSchema.from.

We need to import necessary classes.

Potentially need to handle URISyntaxException; test methods can declare throws Exception.

Add comments.

Let's write test class extending same name. Already defined class JsonSchema_findLexicalRoot_Test with two tests. We'll add more tests.

Test 1: rootHasId_ReturnsSelf

Test 2: leafNoIdNoParent_ReturnsSelf

Test 3: grandChild_NoIdMidParentHasId_ReturnsRoot (already similar to child case but with two levels). We'll create root with $id, mid without, leaf without. Expect root.

Test 4: deepLeaf_AllNoId_ReturnsTopmost (three levels). Already similar to NoIdInChain but deeper.

But we already have NoIdInChain test; we can keep it and add deeper version.

Make sure to use distinct variable names.
